notes.title: Interaction Issue Identified – Fix in Progress
notes.content:
[h2]🎮 Notice Regarding Interaction Issues[/h2][p][/p][p]Dear players,[/p][p][/p][p]We've received your feedback and identified an issue where some players are [b]unable to interact with certain elements in the game[/b] (such as opening doors or picking up objects). We understand how frustrating this can be and sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.[/p][p][/p][p]🎯 Please rest assured that we are [b]actively working on a fix[/b] and will release an update as soon as possible to resolve this issue.[/p][p][/p][p]✅ Once the fix is live, we will notify you through another announcement. Make sure to keep your game updated![/p][p][/p][p]🛠 In the meantime, if you're experiencing any issues, feel free to share them on our Steam Community page or contact us at "interactivenightfall@gmail.com".[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience and support.
Happy gaming!
[/p][p][b]- Nightfall Interactive Development Team[/b][/p]

tags.bug: unable to interact with certain elements in the game

notes.title: Update v.1.0.2
notes.content: [p][b]Camera Angle Adjustment System Added and Identified Bugs Fixed[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]New Feature[/h2][list][*][p]An adjustment option has been added for the camera's POV value.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Identified Bugs[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Delay issues occurring during interactions have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]FPS optimization has been implemented.[/p][/*][*][p]The non-functional "Gamma" percentage setting in the settings menu has been removed and replaced with a notification displaying "Low" and "High" options.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Delay issues occurring during interactions have been fixed.
The non-functional "Gamma" percentage setting in the settings menu has been removed and replaced with a notification displaying "Low" and "High" options.

notes.title: Update v.1.0.1

You can now enjoy a longer and more stable early access experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Animation glitches in the final scene have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Glare problems on certain objects have been corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]FPS (frames per second) improvements have been made.[/p][/*][/list]
